record_revision.description: Append-only revision of this calibration identity; it must equal scientific_claim_ref.target_revision, and target_id cannot change across revisions.

relation_direction.description: The source occurrence or grouped source spans are classified relative to the normalized contribution-role ScientificClaim.

relation.description: Let S be the cited source proposition (or conjunction of grouped spans) and N the normalized claim. EQUIVALENT means S entails N and N entails S with the same facets. CONSERVATIVE_PARAPHRASE preserves the source assertion without adding a facet and permits terminology normalization or explicit conservative weakening (S entails N). BROADER_THAN means S entails N but N does not entail S because S asserts additional cases or scope. NARROWER_THAN means N entails S but S does not entail N because S has fewer cases or stronger conditions. PARTIAL_OVERLAP means neither straightforwardly entails the other, including different asserted facets. UNRESOLVED means no justified ordering is available.
